changelog: **Documentation and changelog wording made tenant-neutral (#2915):** tenant- and operator-specific notes left the public docs; the remaining docs, `CHANGELOG.md` and the `/release-notes` entries now speak of "the MARKETING tenant", "an upstream source system", "the operator" and "the marketing hosts (`MARKETING_HOSTS`)" ("the Marketing CRM" in user-facing notes, EN/TR/DE kept in parity), with no price figures, hostnames or source-system internals. The product-usage feed contract is now the generic `docs/usage-feed.md`; release entries whose linked commit message named a tenant keep their date but drop the commit link (`commit` is optional on `ReleaseNote`). The contact address in README, CONTRIBUTING and the Code of Conduct is 21072026@ersah.in. `CLAUDE.md` gains the rule that tenant names never enter this repo.
